items.title: 25.3.2 The Loss of Energy between Trophic Levels (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of energy loss between trophic levels, printed pages 234-235.

blocks.text: Ecosystem mein aam taur par teen ya chaar trophic levels hote hain. Pehle trophic level, yaani producers, par girne wali sooraj ki tawanai ka sirf taqreeban 1 se 2% organic maadde ki bond-energy (kimiyai tawanai) mein badalta hai. Tawanai jab agle trophic levels ki taraf behti hai to har level se agle level tak sirf taqreeban 10% muntaqil hoti hai. Har trophic level par tawanai zaya (lost) hoti hai. Is tarah mukhtalif levels ke jandaron ke jismon mein istemal aur jama hone ke baad nizam mein kaam ki tawanai bohat kam bachti hai.

blocks.alt: Hare patte par khata hua bhunra (beetle). Us se teen jamni teer batate hain ke khoraak ki tawanai kahan jati hai: 50% Feces (fuzla), 33% Cellular respiration aur 17% Growth (barhotri).
blocks.caption: Figure 25.5: Heterotroph mein tawanai ka istemal (kitab ki Figure 25.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Maslan agar producers photosynthesis se 10,000 kcal tawanai fix karein, to primary consumers ko is mein se sirf 1,000 kcal milegi. Is mein se taqreeban 100 kcal secondary consumers ke jismon mein jama hogi. Agar tertiary consumers secondary consumers ko khayen to unhein shuru mein nizam mein aane wali 10,000 kcal mein se sirf taqreeban 10 kcal milegi.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Chhoti food chains (kam trophic levels wali) lambi food chains (zyada trophic levels wali) ke muqable mein tawanai ke lehaaz se zyada kar-aamad (efficient) hoti hain. Wajah yeh hai ke har trophic level par tawanai muntaqil hote waqt garmi (heat) ban kar zaya hoti hai. Is liye food chain mein jitne kam qadam hon, efficiency utni zyada hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Tawanai ki seerhi. Producers (darakht aur ghaas) ki hari takhti mein 10,000 kcal, suraj se tawanai ka teer. Neele teer upar jaate hain: primary consumer (khargosh) ka bara cube 1,000 kcal; secondary consumer (saanp) ka chhota cube 100 kcal; tertiary consumer (uqaab) ka nanha cube 10 kcal. Har qadam par peela 'Heat loss' (garmi ka zayaa) teer nikalta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.6: Trophic levels mein tawanai ka bahao (kitab ki Figure 25.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har cube pichhle ka sirf taqreeban 10% hai: 10,000 se 1,000, phir 100, phir 10 kcal. Baqi tawanai har qadam par zyada tar garmi (heat loss) ban kar nikal jati hai, is liye food chain mein 3-4 se zyada levels kam hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Agar producers 50,000 kcal fix karein to secondary consumers tak taqreeban kitni tawanai pohanchegi?
blocks.explanation: Har qadam par taqreeban 10%: 50,000 → 5,000 kcal (primary consumers) → taqreeban 500 kcal (secondary consumers).

items: Producers dhoop ka sirf 1-2% organic maadde mein jama karte hain; har agle level tak sirf taqreeban 10% jata hai.
Chhoti food chains zyada efficient hain kyun ke har qadam par tawanai garmi ban kar zaya hoti hai.
